title: Generate Parentheses
description: Generates all combinations of well-formed parentheses given 'n' pairs using a backtracking approach. For this trace, 'n' is set to 2.

steps.note: Starting `generateParenthesis` function with `n = 2`.
Initialize `result` array to store valid combinations.
Initial call to `backtrack` with an empty string, 0 open parentheses, and 0 close parentheses.
Checking base case: `open_count` (0) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (0) === `n` (2) is false. Current string: ''
Condition `open_count` (0) < `n` (2) is true. We can add an open parenthesis.
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "("`, `open_count = 1`, `close_count = 0`.
Checking base case: `open_count` (1) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (0) === `n` (2) is false. Current string: '('
Condition `open_count` (1) < `n` (2) is true. We can add another open parenthesis.
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "(("`, `open_count = 2`, `close_count = 0`.
Checking base case: `open_count` (2) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (0) === `n` (2) is false. Current string: '(('
Condition `open_count` (2) < `n` (2) is false. Cannot add more open parentheses as `open_count` has reached `n`.
Condition `close_count` (0) < `open_count` (2) is true. We can add a close parenthesis.
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "(()"`, `open_count = 2`, `close_count = 1`.
Checking base case: `open_count` (2) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (1) === `n` (2) is false. Current string: '(()'
Condition `open_count` (2) < `n` (2) is false. Cannot add more open parentheses.
Condition `close_count` (1) < `open_count` (2) is true. We can add another close parenthesis.
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "(())"`, `open_count = 2`, `close_count = 2`.
Base case met! `open_count` (2) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (2) === `n` (2) is true. Current string: '(())'
Add the valid combination `"(())"` to the `result` array.
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Finished options for `current_string = "(()"`. Backtracking up the call stack.
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Finished options for `current_string = "(("`. Backtracking up the call stack.
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Condition `close_count` (0) < `open_count` (1) is true. We can add a close parenthesis. (From `current_string = "("`)
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "()"`, `open_count = 1`, `close_count = 1`.
Checking base case: `open_count` (1) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (1) === `n` (2) is false. Current string: '()'
Condition `open_count` (1) < `n` (2) is true. We can add an open parenthesis.
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "()("`, `open_count = 2`, `close_count = 1`.
Checking base case: `open_count` (2) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (1) === `n` (2) is false. Current string: '()('
Condition `open_count` (2) < `n` (2) is false. Cannot add more open parentheses.
Condition `close_count` (1) < `open_count` (2) is true. We can add a close parenthesis.
Recursively call `backtrack` with `current_string = "()()"`, `open_count = 2`, `close_count = 2`.
Base case met! `open_count` (2) === `n` (2) AND `close_count` (2) === `n` (2) is true. Current string: '()()'
Add the valid combination `"()()"` to the `result` array.
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Finished options for `current_string = "()("`. Backtracking up the call stack.
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Condition `close_count` (1) < `open_count` (1) is false. Cannot add more close parentheses as `close_count` equals `open_count`. (From `current_string = "()"`)
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Finished options for `current_string = "("`. Backtracking up the call stack.
Return from current `backtrack` call.
Condition `close_count` (0) < `open_count` (0) is false. Cannot add a close parenthesis. (From `current_string = ""`)
Return from the initial `backtrack` call.
All combinations generated. Return the final `result` array.
